$comment: site shape: { name, home, labels: { menu, closeMenu, ... }, header: { menu: [{ label, href?, children?: [{ label, href }] }], phone, cta: { label, href }, sticky } }. No logo, so the site name is the wordmark. With no menu the nav, phone, call to action and theme toggle are not drawn; the burger always is.
summary: A header for a site with no logo image, menu, phone number, call to action or theme toggle: the site name as the wordmark and the burger.
